(DEFUN FOO ((A B)) (LIST B A))
seems to be accepted by lisp but does the following:

(DEFUN FOO (G0003)
       (COMMENT ARGLIST = ((A B)))
       (LET (A)
	    (DESETQ A G0003)
	    (LIST B A)))

This doesn't seem quite like what I had hoped it would do...
